t: You're at Kennington tube station on Kennington Park Road, on the Northern line. It sits at the junction where the Charing Cross and Bank branches meet to the north, and the Morden and Battersea Power Station branches split to the south. Waterloo and Elephant and Castle are the next stops northbound. It's in fare zones 1 and 2. The rapper and singer Blanco, born in 1999 and a former member of the drill group Harlem Spartans, was born in Kennington.
